observations.body: The LORD sends a messenger to prepare the way before the desired lord and covenant messenger comes.
observations.label: A messenger prepares for a sudden arrival: action

observations.body: Arrival brings refining, purified service, acceptable offerings, and judgment.

observations.body: my messenger · prepare the way · suddenly come · refine
